conflicts.explicit_vs_history: If strict reconstruction conflicts with an explicit object/outfit, do not secretly replace it. Offer or internally select an intentional-hybrid interpretation only when the user has permitted adaptation.
conflicts.identity_vs_style: Translate rendering/material while preserving identity according to the selected identity mode; style cannot silently redesign ancestry or face geometry.
conflicts.reference_role_overlap: If one reference has multiple explicit roles, only those roles may transfer. If multiple references claim the same role, use user priority/weight or ask only when the outcome materially depends on it.
conflicts.art_method_vs_form: The art method controls fabrication/material; the artifact form controls geometry. If incompatible, choose neither silently—flag the conflict.
conflicts.era_vs_overlay: Historical era/site is the evidence base; Wuxia/Xianxia are overlays. Overlay narrative cannot be reclassified as historical evidence.
conflicts.director_vs_material: Director choices must respect physical material limits; spectacular pose/lighting cannot require impossible fabrication.
